commit.message: Add changed favicon file format from SVG to PNG
Typo hotfix
Use sql query on index
Add site metadata, move components, refactor pages
Improved error handling
Add lazy loading and 404 page tweaks
Refactor Layout.astro based of Prettier [skip deploy]

Migrate Scrobble to React component

Replace the previous Scrobble.astro with a React Scrobble.jsx component that uses hooks for fetching and rendering Last.FM data.
Update responsive breakpoints
Update site titles

Add gallery page that use @libsql/client

Minor tweaks: normalize quoting/indentation in astro.config.mjs and reduce a pseudo-element z-index in src/styles/global.css.
Add Back to Top button to footer
Add subtle hover interactions to UI

Refactor Scrobble UI and add phosphor image filter

Replace the small "LIVE" badge with a "NOW PLAYING" label and simplify the Scrobble card markup (move artwork out of the group wrapper, clamp title to 2 lines, add hover brightness). Convert recent tracks to a 2-column grid with right-aligned artist names. Add an SVG "phosphor" color filter to Layout.astro and corresponding .phosphor-filter CSS with a hover transition in global.css to style album artwork and improve visuals.

Remove pop-in animation

Delete the inline script in Layout.astro that added staggered "animate-pop-in" classes, and remove the corresponding @keyframes pop-in and .animate-pop-in rules from global.css.

AJAX-ed Last.fm component

Replace server-side Last.fm fetch in Scrobble.astro with a client-side widget that polls a new API route. This enables realtime updates in the UI and removes the build-time fetch from the component.
Add GitHub contributions heatmap

Move components into static/ and update imports

Moved CommitLog, Radar, and Scrobble to src/components/static/ to group static UI components.

Inline stack icons and simplify Radar component

Move stack icon data into the index page and render the stack icon grid inline there; remove the Radar component's static icon list and markup (Radar.astro now only contains the chart scripts). Remove the Radar import and canvas from src/pages/index.astro, add a local `stack` array, and render the icon grid directly. Also move the Ascii component placement and add an opacity tweak for its styling. Minor UI tweak in src/pages/projects.astro: remove the bold font weight from repository name.

Format Scrobble.astro and tweak recent tracks UI

Reformatted src/components/Scrobble.astro for consistent indentation and spacing.

Update .prettierrc [skip deploy]

Add "useTabs": true to .prettierrc so Prettier formats code using tabs instead of spaces.
Moved Radar to a separate component

Refactor social links into mapped array

Replace duplicated social link markup with a mapped render of anchor+img elements. Index now includes name labels for each social link and displays icon+text, while Layout uses the same array to render icon links.

Update UI, fonts, and LastFM component

Add new assets and refine UI/typography: add two woff2 fonts (Terminus and ibm_vga_8x16), remove old TTF. Register fonts in global.css and set --font-mono to Terminus.

Redesigned footer

The layout now fetches the latest commit JSON from the repo and displays a linked short SHA with a commit icon, plus social links and updated footer styling. Small props destructuring whitespace was also adjusted.

Increase main horizontal padding to px-5

Change the main selector's Tailwind @apply from px-4 to px-5 to slightly increase horizontal spacing. Responsive md:px-30 and other spacing remain unchanged.
Add SVG favicons and reference in Layout.astro

Refactor Scrobble.astro fetch and markup

Simplify the Last.fm fetch by assigning the JSON response directly. The anchor and container classes were also reorganized.

Move icons to icons/stack and update refs

Reorganize SVG assets by moving several icons into new folders. Also update references.
Simplify homepage hero and update layout
